instruction: I want to hide the line numbers in the editor, please help modify the setting of VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to turn off line numbers in the editor. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly applied in settings.json.
